name: steppe_granite
about: Rule fill for granite tor steppe (Govisumber): what the 0.83 m/px photo cannot resolve (rocks < ~2 m, shrubs, grass). Densities are per 100 m2 by surface class (classify.CLASS_IDS names); a class not listed has 0. Sizes are [min, max] metres per axis, drawn uniformly; l >= w is enforced after the draw.

_why.scree: Granite tors shed blocks that roll and creep downslope: scree lies in a band below the rock edge, its width ~ scree_band_per_height x the source rock's height (thickness for DEM-topped masses), capped at scree_band_m (a DEM-topped large mass counts as the scree_source_percentile of its thickness: its rim is ~0 thick by construction); density falls linearly across the band. downslope_bias = share of the weight that follows the fall line (cos of the angle to it); it reaches full strength at slopes >= downslope_full_deg (on flat ground scree rings the rock). Sizes stay below the ~2 m photo resolution limit (rocks >= 2 m are traced).
_why.stone: Small weathered stones and grus near rock: density at the rock edge, falling linearly to 0 at stone_reach_m. Nothing rocky far from traced rock (open sand stays open).
_why.scrub: Caragana-type shrubs: the dark speckled class (SCRUB) at 1-2 m crowns 2-4 m apart in the imagery; sparse on grass, rare on sand. Thicker at rock feet (moisture/shelter) and along dry channels.
_why.tree: None at this site (zero density); the type exists for other sites.
_why.grass: Relative density 0-1 for the GrassField mask; boosted at rock feet and along channels, none on track, under rock or at the gers.
_why.fill_coverage: Ruling 28: seen from above the fill must cover the mass outline (>= 85 %), as the class map shows solid rock there. A loose packing of 2-10 m pieces at overlap_frac leaves the gaps between round pieces and a ~1 m strip along the outline, so a gap pass packs the outline again over a 0.5 m candidate grid with 0.75-2 m pieces (below the 2 m photo resolution: these fill gaps, they are not traced rocks) overlapping up to gap.overlap_frac; 0.75 m (not 1 m) reaches the strip along the outline, which 1 m pieces left at 82 % coverage on the small masses of the smoke site. A slab is at least slab_reveal_m above the highest ground under it: a pavement sheet lies on the ground surface, and on a slope a slab based at the lowest ground was buried by the terrain upslope (35 % of slab area at Sumber).
_why.fill: Masses (outline polygons) are packed with pieces up to the mass top: ground + height, or the DEM top for masses >= 60 m long (Ruling 15). Where a large mass is < pavement_thickness_m thick it is flat sheet granite (Ruling 18): slabs. Thick parts are stacks of round pieces (Ruling 22: how granite tors stand): each piece at most max_h_over_l x its length high, each one up stack_shrink x the one below and turned by up to stack_turn_deg, resting on it (scatter y = base above the ground). fill_round sizes span the traced boulders' long axes (p5 3.5 m - p95 9.4 m) down to the 2 m resolution limit.
